sentences.en: I can see a mountain far away.
sentences.zh: 我能看到远处的一座山。

sentences.en: The sea looks very big from here.
There are many houses in the distance.
I see the sun going down behind the mountain.
sentences.zh: 我看到太阳在山后面落下。

sentences.en: The trees look small because they are far away.
sentences.zh: 那些树看起来很小，因为它们很远。

sentences.en: I want to go to that far place one day.
sentences.zh: 我想有一天去那个遥远的地方。

sentences.en: The sky seems bigger when I look far.
sentences.zh: 当我看远处时，天空显得更大。

sentences.en: There is a river between here and the mountain.
sentences.zh: 这里和山之间有一条河。

sentences.en: I like to watch the faraway clouds.
The world looks beautiful from a high place.
